**Replay and timeout migration:** Independent per-property random streams can change old sample sequences, so an old `--seed N --expect-fail NAME` may no longer reproduce. Keep the old checker for exact replays, revalidate recorded commands, and pin known counterexamples in `examples`. Both checkers now default to 90 s per run / 10 s per call: previously completing long checks can become inconclusive (exit 3); a `bounded_check.py` model-call timeout remains exit 2. Both accept `--timeout 0` and `--call-timeout 0` to disable the respective limit independently (`CHECK_TIMEOUT = 0` also disables the run limit after import).
